summary: The diff shows that the Header component has been successfully modified to include a visible Admin link in the navigation menu. The Admin link is properly configured with routing to '/admin', includes conditional styling for active state, and is positioned alongside the Products link. All requirements from the BuildRequest appear to be implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: Active state styling for Admin link using matchRoute and conditional className
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only required the Admin link to be visible, clickable, and have consistent styling with other navigation links. The implementation adds active state highlighting (changing text color when on /admin route) which was not requested.
